frontend.line: Sign-in redirect loop: /login must be in publicRoutes in apps/web/middleware.ts and afterSignInUrl must be /dashboard (login page and NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_IN_URL).
State: server state is TanStack Query, client state is zustand; never mix them.
Styling is Tailwind v4, CSS-first config in apps/web/app/globals.css (@theme tokens); never create tailwind.config.js.
Invoice dates show in org.timeZone via formatDate(iso, timeZone), not UTC (Vancouver agencies saw wrong day). OrgSummary type lacks timeZone (Org has it).
Invoice.lineItems is optional (API omits it for drafts); guard it or draft detail pages crash (Sentry WEB-1F3).
Only status=open invoices can be overdue; drafts and voided never count (OverdueBadge).
'Module not found: Can't resolve fs' = server-only module in client bundle; add import "server-only" and use server component/route handler.

Skeleton (components/ui/Skeleton) is a default export plus SkeletonText; InvoiceRow was renamed InvoiceListItem (props InvoiceListItemProps) in acme-431-overdue-badge-drafts, conflicting with Lena's in-progress branch.

Jordan's personal trailmix app (Django+htmx): add-hike form uses hx-disabled-elt and hx-sync="this:drop"; uploads need hx-encoding=multipart/form-data; GPX validated by hikes/validators.py validate_gpx (defusedxml, 10 MB cap).

debugging.line: Sign-in redirect loop: /login missing from publicRoutes in apps/web/middleware.ts or afterSignInUrl not /dashboard.
API auth: requireAuth in apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts (@clerk/backend) returns 401 token_expired / invalid_token.
Wrong invoice day in UI: dates must use org.timeZone, not UTC.
Image upload crash on dashboard startup: after switching Node versions run `pnpm rebuild sharp`; don't run terminal under Rosetta on Apple Silicon.
API test suite hangs (not fails) when Docker is stopped (Testcontainers); check `docker info`.
GET /healthz on localhost:4000 returns 200 only if Postgres and Redis are both up.
'Can't resolve fs' build error: server-only module imported client-side; add import "server-only".
Duplicate customer reminders came from RabbitMQ redeliveries; invoice-reminder is idempotent via db.reminderLog.claim.
Excel garbles accented CSV names; use CLI invoices export --bom (off by default, CSV only).
Staging API gives ~40s 502s during deploys; CLI apiGet retries 502/503/504 up to 3 times.
Draft invoice detail crash: lineItems omitted by API for drafts (Sentry WEB-1F3).
Jordan wants a short bullet-list summary when a task finishes, not paragraphs.

code-style.line: Never mix TanStack Query (server state) and zustand (client state).
Logging: pino structured logs only; no console.log.
Node 18 LTS everywhere: no toSorted, toReversed, Object.groupBy, Array.fromAsync, Promise.withResolvers. Leftover Object.groupBy in apps/web/lib/group.ts (deferred).
Biome: `pnpm lint` (biome check .); `pnpm biome check --write <path>` autofixes; line width 120.

tests.line: Worker tests: `pnpm --filter worker test`, uses ioredis-mock, no real Redis.
API tests use Testcontainers real DB; Docker must run or suite hangs (check `docker info`).
CLI tests (packages/cli) are Vitest stdout snapshot tests.
CI fails if line coverage < 80%; add tests for new route behavior.

build-ci.line: Standing rule: never run destructive DB commands (drop, truncate, reset) without asking Jordan, even locally; local reset = remove volume acme-platform_dbdata, compose up db redis, run migrate.ts then seed.ts.
Package manager conflict: root pins yarn 1.22.22 with yarn.lock v1; CI runs `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`, so commit updated yarn.lock with package.json changes. Other rows use pnpm commands.
`pnpm dev` at root starts web, api, worker via Turborepo; turbo.json build depends on ^build and openapi.
OpenAPI spec generated from zod: `pnpm turbo run openapi --filter api`; never hand-edit openapi.yaml.
Node 18 LTS everywhere; avoid Node 20+ APIs.
CLI bundled by tsup to dist/index.js (ESM, node18, shebang, bin acme); run from source: `pnpm --filter @acme/cli dev -- <args>`, ACME_API_URL sets the API.
After switching Node versions run `pnpm rebuild sharp`; avoid Rosetta terminal.
Worker image: node:20-slim + apt libvips, not alpine (sharp segfaults on musl); shrink via multi-stage with production node_modules only.
Secrets: dev in 1Password vault acme-dev, prod in AWS Secrets Manager; .env.example gets placeholder + comment only.
Docker must be running for API tests (suite hangs otherwise).
'Can't resolve fs' build error: add import "server-only".

jobs.line: Worker consumes RabbitMQ queues invoices.reminders, webhooks.outbound, exports; one consumer per queue.
Jobs retry with exponential backoff (5 attempts), then dead-letter queue dlq and Slack #alerts.
invoice-reminder job is idempotent via db.reminderLog.claim(invoiceId, kind, sentOn) on reminder_log (unique invoice_id/kind/sent_on); redeliveries caused duplicate emails before.
Worker autoscaled by KEDA on queue length (1-20 replicas, 1 per 50 messages); manifests in infra/k8s/.
Worker tests: `pnpm --filter worker test` with ioredis-mock.

git.line: Standing rule: never use git stash; commit WIP to the branch.
Branches start with lowercase Linear id (ACME team), e.g. acme-123-short-slug.
Commits use Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:, optional scope).
Every PR needs one CODEOWNERS approval and green CI; no CODEOWNERS line for packages/cli/ (falls back to @acme/eng-leads), add an owner before the CLI export PR.
packages/cli/dist/index.js is tracked (force-added), stale, hand-patched by Marco Bianchi in a91c3e2; Jordan said ask Marco first and leave it.
Use Changesets (`pnpm changeset`) for user-facing changes.
Branch changing package.json must commit updated yarn.lock or CI install fails.
Branch acme-431-overdue-badge-drafts renames InvoiceRow to InvoiceListItem; conflicts with Lena's in-progress branch.
Ownership: Lena Fischer apps/web, Marco Bianchi apps/api and services/worker, Priya Shah infra/ and .github/.
Jordan wants a short bullet-list summary at task end.

api.line: API is Express 4; requireAuth in apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts verifies Clerk JWTs, 401 token_expired / invalid_token.
DB connect retry window connectRetryWindowMs must stay >= 120_000 (RDS failover took 90s).
GET /healthz on :4000 checks Postgres and Redis.
DB via PgBouncer transaction mode: prepare:false required; added to pool.ts and driver.ts options but driver doesn't yet pass it to raw pool.
API omits lineItems for draft invoices (routes/invoices.ts).
Only open invoices can be overdue.
OpenAPI apps/api/openapi.yaml generated from zod schemas: `pnpm turbo run openapi --filter api`; don't hand-edit.
CLI invoices export has --bom flag (CSV only, off by default) for Excel accents.
Staging 502s ~40s during deploys; CLI apiGet retries; point CLI with ACME_API_URL.
CI coverage >= 80%; add tests for new route behavior.

release.line: Changesets: run `pnpm changeset` for user-facing changes (invoice timezone counted).
CLI release: merge Changesets version PR, publish job runs `npm publish --provenance`.
CLI bundled by tsup to dist/index.js; tracked dist/index.js is stale, hand-patched by Marco (a91c3e2); ask Marco first, leave it.
Licensing: repo proprietary (Acme Inc.), packages/cli MIT.
Flags in GrowthBook; invoices export behind cli-invoices-export, still needs creating.
No CODEOWNERS line for packages/cli/; add owner before CLI export PR.
Planned exports bucket acme-<env>-exports (infra/s3-exports.tf, branch acme-424-exports-bucket) for CLI export later; staging plan 4 to add, not applied.

database.line: Standing rule: never run destructive DB commands (drop, truncate, reset) without asking Jordan, even locally.
Jordan states DB is MySQL 8 (docs/architecture.md updated); API owns schema, migrations in apps/api/migrations. Some docs/other notes still say Postgres (conflict).
Prod DB is RDS Multi-AZ, 14-day backups; restore to a new instance, never over live. Failover took 90s; keep connectRetryWindowMs >= 120_000.
PgBouncer transaction mode: prepare:false; driver doesn't yet pass it to raw pool.
reminder_log has unique (invoice_id, kind, sent_on) for idempotent reminders.
Only open invoices can be overdue.
Local reset: remove volume acme-platform_dbdata, compose up db redis, run apps/api/scripts/migrate.ts (47 migrations) and seed.ts; needs Jordan's ok.

observability.line: pino structured logging only; no console.log.
Sentry for errors (SENTRY_DSN), including CLI failures.
GET /healthz (localhost:4000) 200 only if Postgres and Redis up.
Cluster is EKS acme-prod (use for logs).
CloudWatch alarm api-stripe-webhook-5xx (>5 5xx in 5 min) pages PagerDuty on-call via SNS pagerduty-oncall, at night too.

Secrets: dev in 1Password vault acme-dev, prod in AWS Secrets Manager; .env.example placeholders only.
Worker image node:20-slim + apt libvips, not alpine (sharp segfault, Priya, e22b9d0).
Prod Postgres RDS Multi-AZ, restores to new instance; failover 90s so keep DB retry window >= 2 min; rollback docs still TODO.
Stripe webhook 5xx alarm pages on-call via PagerDuty.
Exports bucket plan (infra/s3-exports.tf, acme-424-exports-bucket): private, AES256, 30-day expiry; staging plan not applied.
